subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should #88992's stranded `message_tool_only` finals recover only behind the new default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` flag, recover by default through the successor approach, or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: Current docs define no message-tool call as private/no source reply, while this PR adds a new config surface and replays private final text into a bounded retry, so automation cannot safely choose the product/privacy policy.

options.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
options.body: Approve this PR's default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no private metadata leakage.

options.title: Prefer default recovery
options.body: Use a refreshed successor approach if maintainers want existing `message_tool_only` users protected without adding a config flag.

options.title: Stay diagnostics-only
options.body: Reject runtime recovery and keep the warning/docs behavior if preserving the strict privacy contract matters more than automatic recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
recommendation.body: Approve this PR's default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no private metadata leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and rewrote the current diagnostics-only policy PR, making him the strongest history signal for this product/privacy choice.
